capabilities.description: Compose a standard business-axis proposal without merging distinct ideas.
Recommend direct, same-industry, or adjacent-industry media with a visible fallback contract.
Select restrained brand, reveal, and transition motion with mobile and reduced-motion variants.
Audit desktop, tablet, mobile, print, text zoom, touch targets, clipping, and horizontal overflow.
Detect ARKAON, audit, iteration, development, and implementation terms that should not appear in a family-facing proposal.
Prepare staged transition from read-only proposal to controlled editor, collaboration, and approved operations handoff.
